glossary.Lock: Hide an app's windows behind the unlock prompt. Verb and state: 'Lock all now', 'Spotify is locked'.
glossary.Unlock: Prove it's the owner so a locked app shows again. Never 'open', 'release' or 'authenticate'.
glossary.App PIN: Latch's own 6 to 12 digit PIN. Never 'password', 'passcode' or 'Windows PIN'.
glossary.Passkey: A passkey on the owner's phone or security key, never on this PC. Never 'FIDO', 'WebAuthn' or 'security code'.
glossary.Grace period: Time after an unlock when relaunching the app doesn't ask again.
glossary.Windows Hello: The system face, fingerprint or Windows PIN check. Always written in full.
glossary.Needs attention: The section for problems the owner should see. Never 'Alerts' or 'Warnings'.
glossary.Date rule: Relative by calendar day under 7 days (Today, Yesterday, Monday), absolute after (12 Nov 2026).
glossary.Style: Sentence case everywhere. '…' only on actions that open something. 'Try again' is the one retry label.
